Body.Content:
What and why

We are updating the SharePoint FAQ web part authoring experience. The FAQ web part will provide a standard, non-AI experience for manually creating, editing, and managing FAQ content. AI-assisted FAQ creation and import capabilities will move to the Copilot in SharePoint authoring experience, where authors can use natural language prompts and selected grounding sources to generate FAQ content that is saved to the compatible FAQ web part. Existing FAQ web parts and their content will continue to render; no content migration is necessary.

Rollout schedule

  • General Availability (Worldwide and GCC): Rollout begins in late October 2026 and is expected to complete in early November 2026.

Impact on your organization

Who is affected

  • SharePoint authors who create or edit FAQs on SharePoint Pages and News posts.
  • Users who use AI-assisted authoring to generate or import FAQ content.

Platforms and services

  • SharePoint Online
  • SharePoint News posts
  • SharePoint FAQ web part
  • Copilot in SharePoint

What will happen

  • Authors can continue to manually create and manage FAQ content directly in the FAQ web part without using AI.
  • AI-assisted FAQ creation and import capabilities will move from the FAQ web part to the Copilot in SharePoint authoring experience.
  • Authors will be able to use natural language prompts and selected grounding sources in Copilot in SharePoint to generate FAQ content.
  • Generated FAQ content will be saved to the compatible FAQ web part.
  • Existing FAQ web parts and their content will continue to render as they do currently; no content migration is required.

Action required and recommendations

No administrative action is required. We recommend that you:

  • Inform SharePoint authors and site owners about this change to the FAQ authoring experience.
  • Review and update internal training materials, support documentation, and governance guidance that reference the current AI-assisted FAQ authoring workflow.

Learn more

  • Authoring with Copilot in SharePoint: An overview | Microsoft Support

Compliance considerations

No compliance considerations identified. Review as appropriate for your organization.
